description: Host-side limits that do not depend on the board or firmware (DCA1000 link and throughput, cfg heuristics). Same entry shape as config/firmware/<id>.json limits; read by radar_gui/cfg/limits.py.

dca1000_ethernet_mbps.source: DCA1000EVM User's Guide SPRUIJ4A host PC configuration (1-Gbps Ethernet port); docs/RESULTS.md

dca1000_max_mbps.source: docs/research/gui_board_limits_single_chip.md row 15: DCA1000 UG Table 19, TI's theoretical maximum at 5 us packet delay (545 / 325 / 193 Mb/s at 10 / 25 / 50 us)

dca1000_packet_overhead_us.source: docs/research/gui_board_limits_single_chip.md row 15: two-parameter fit rate = packet_bytes*8 / (packet_delay_us + 11.5 us) to the four TI points (within 2 Mb/s); per-board packet_bytes and packet_delay_us come from config/boards/<board>.json dca1000

duty_warn.source: heuristic, no TI duty-cycle limit exists (single-chip memo row 16); real constraint is the min_frame_blank_us rule
